title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Everything you need to know about setting up your organization, billing cycles, and enterprise migration.

pageSectionLists.title: How does Ozikol handle multi-region tenant isolation?
pageSectionLists.description: Every tenant organization operates within its isolated logical boundary with dedicated schema isolation and encrypted connection keys.

pageSectionLists.title: Can we self-host custom templates on our own domain?
pageSectionLists.description: Yes! Custom CNAME routing allows you to point any domain with automatic Let’s Encrypt SSL certificate provisioning.

pageSectionLists.title: What happens if we surpass our monthly API bandwidth quota?
pageSectionLists.description: We never hard-throttle production traffic. We alert your administration team with real-time telemetry alerts before auto-scaling.

pageSectionLists.title: Is there a technical onboarding team available for migration?
pageSectionLists.description: All Pro Growth and Enterprise accounts include dedicated Slack and Microsoft Teams bridges with our SRE leads.
